home.hero_body: Architectural wall pieces, precision-cut in steel and made to fit your space.
home.hero_alt: Intricate CNC-cut metal wall art mounted on concrete
home.intro_heading: Metalwork that changes the character of a room.
home.intro_body: We turn considered linework into lasting objects. Each piece is cut in steel, refined by hand, and made to sit naturally within contemporary spaces.
home.why_intro: Considered design, precise fabrication, and practical details that make every piece easier to choose, install, and live with.
home.why_1_body: Clean, deliberate lines are translated into steel with close control over every detail.
home.why_2_body: Durable metal and a matte black powder-coated finish keep the artwork looking refined over time.
home.why_3_body: Choose standard dimensions or request custom proportions suited to the wall you have in mind.
home.why_4_body: Each design is planned for straightforward mounting, with practical installation guidance included.
home.why_5_body: Every piece is inspected and carefully packed to protect its edges and finish in transit.
home.custom_body: Bring us a name, reference, sketch, or empty wall. We will shape it into a considered metal artwork made for your dimensions.
home.custom_note: No finished drawing required. Start with whatever you have.
home.custom_image_alt: Custom metal wall artwork displayed in an interior
home.recent_intro: Freshly released pieces, ready to give a wall its next focal point.
home.faq_intro: The practical details to know before choosing a piece for your space.
home.faq_1_question: What are MetaliQ artworks made from?
home.faq_1_answer: Our pieces are precision-cut from metal and finished in matte black powder coating for a durable, refined surface. Material thickness can vary by design, so check the product page or contact us when you need a specific specification.
home.faq_2_question: How do I choose the right size for my wall?
home.faq_2_answer: Measure the available wall area and leave enough open space around the artwork for it to breathe. Product pages include available dimensions, and we can help recommend a scale when you share your wall measurements or a straight-on photograph.
home.faq_3_question: Can you create a completely custom design?
home.faq_3_answer: Yes. You can begin with a name, reference image, sketch, idea, or simply the dimensions of an empty wall. We refine the concept with you and ask for design approval before custom production begins.
home.faq_4_answer: The mounting approach depends on the artwork and the wall surface. We provide installation guidance for the selected piece. Use anchors appropriate for your wall type, and consult a professional installer whenever you are unsure about the surface or weight.
home.faq_5_question: Can I display the artwork outdoors?
home.faq_5_answer: Treat a piece as indoor-only unless its product page specifically describes it as suitable for outdoor use. Contact us before ordering for an exterior space so we can confirm whether the matte black powder-coated finish is appropriate for the location.
home.faq_6_question: How long will my order take to arrive?
home.faq_6_answer: Standard Karachi orders are generally delivered within 4-7 working days. Custom designs may require additional production time after approval. We will confirm the expected timeline when the design and order details are finalized.
home.faq_7_question: What should I do if my order arrives damaged?
home.faq_7_answer: Contact us as soon as possible and keep the original packaging. Send clear photographs of the packaging and the affected area so we can review what happened and guide you through the available resolution.
home.faq_8_question: How should I clean and care for metal wall art?
home.faq_8_answer: Remove dust with a clean, soft, dry cloth. Avoid abrasive pads, harsh chemicals, and prolonged moisture, as these can damage the finish. Handle the piece by its stronger edges rather than delicate cut details.

about.cta_heading: Bring a stronger point of view to your wall.
about.operations_title: Online-only, made to order, and built around your space.
about.operations_body: MetaliQ Art does not sell mass-held warehouse stock. Catalog and bespoke pieces are prepared after order or quote confirmation using CNC cutting for precise, repeatable detail. Each piece then moves through finishing, quality checking, protective packaging, and nationwide courier fulfilment.
about.catalog_body: Choose a listed design in our matte black powder-coated finish and select supported dimensions. Prices are displayed in PKR, and resized catalog work is calculated by finished area before checkout.
about.bespoke_body: Share a reference, measurements, and delivery location. We confirm the design proof, matte black powder-coated finish, area-based quote, payment schedule, and timing before production.
about.fulfilment_body: Approved designs are translated into cut-ready files, precision-cut in metal, finished, checked, packed, and dispatched from Karachi through a courier partner.
about.legal_body: MetaliQ Art is the customer-facing brand operated by Steed Art, the registered business responsible for customer agreements, order fulfilment, and payment processing.

custom_request.title: Your idea, precisely made in metal.
custom_request.intro: Tell us what you want to create and where it will live. This is a quote request, not an order or payment. Steed Art will review the brief before confirming feasibility, design, price, and timing.
custom_request.step_1: Submit the brief, measurements, delivery location, and reference material.
custom_request.step_2: We review the request and clarify the design, proportions, and production requirements with you.
custom_request.step_3: You receive a written design proof, area-based quote, payment schedule, and delivery estimate.
custom_request.step_4: After written approval and payment confirmation, the piece enters production and is later dispatched.
custom_request.price_note: Custom design work is priced at PKR 1,000 per square foot. The final amount is calculated from the approved dimensions and may include separately disclosed charges for exceptional design or production requirements.
custom_request.upload_fallback: You may include a public Google Drive or Dropbox reference link below. Direct file upload will replace this field once the secure upload service is activated.

journey.title: From your screen to your wall.
journey.intro: MetaliQ Art is an online-only, made-to-order metal art store operated by Steed Art. This page explains how catalog orders, custom requests, payments, production, and delivery work.

journey.catalog_title: A clear path from selection to delivery.
journey.step_1: Browse the catalog and open the product that suits your space.
journey.step_2: Choose either the listed dimensions or a supported custom size. All products use our matte black powder-coated finish.
journey.step_3: Review the final price in Pakistani Rupees. Custom-size catalog pricing is calculated by area.
journey.step_4: Add the piece to your cart and review the order before continuing.
journey.step_5: Enter delivery details in Shopify's secure hosted checkout and review any shipping charge.
journey.step_6: Place the order using an available payment method. Cash on delivery is currently active.
journey.step_7: Receive order confirmation. Paid or confirmed orders are then queued for made-to-order production.
journey.step_8: The finished piece is checked, securely packed, dispatched by courier, and delivered to your address.
journey.custom_title: Custom work begins with a written brief.
journey.custom_body: Submit your contact details, wall dimensions, project description, and reference files. Steed Art reviews the request and confirms the design, matte black powder-coated finish, area-based price, payment amount, and delivery estimate in writing. Production begins only after approval and payment confirmation.
